data.name: Prodyut
data.gender_notes: Prodyut is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who creates or produces, be it an idea, a product, or a child. The name Prodyut carries the meaning “Creator, Producer” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Prodyut usually hope their child will grow to embody creator, producer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who are creators of their own destiny and are blessed with the ability to produce positive change.
data.etymology: Prodyut belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Creator, Producer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Prodyut total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

historical_references.reference: Prodyut is also referred to in the Puranas as the father of the legendary king Shibi, who was renowned for his kindness and generosity.
